note: Johnson County recreation area (the county page calls it Lake DeSmet Recreation Area) on the south shore of Lake DeSmet, 8 mi N of Buffalo off I-90 exit 51, with Bighorn Mountain views. Open gravel camping along the shoreline and in rows of back-in pads; some sites have picnic shelters. Two boat ramps; one restroom open all year. --Claude
summary: Johnson County, FCFS honor-system: 60+ spots $15, 8 electric $20 (stored $20-only low corrected to $15); no water or dump; 14 days in 20. Lakefront kept: on imagery rigs camp on the open red-gravel apron along the shore, ~10-30 m from the water, with the camp road behind them. Pin ~fine. Phone and website confirmed.
flags: WATERFRONT 'lakefront' kept: sites are unnumbered first-come spots, so no site numbers exist. On Esri imagery rigs are parked on the open gravel apron right at the shoreline between about 44.4522,-106.7419 and 44.4522,-106.7406 (and again by the building at the pin around 44.4527,-106.7433), roughly 10-30 m from the water with the campground road BEHIND them - no road or day use between rig and water; these are ordinary nightly honor-system spots. The sheltered sites along the shore road further west (the county's photo) have the road between them and the water - lakeview on their own. Inland back-in pad rows (around 44.4532,-106.7474 and 44.4518,-106.7438) are lakeview at best. Packed red-gravel (clinker) apron, not open beach sand.
FEES: base corrected $20 -> $15 (the non-electric spots a 23-ft rig uses); $20 electric is the high. Amperage not stated - hookups not written.
SITE COUNT not written: page says 'Over 60 overnight camping spots' plus 8 electric - no exact count.
